schema_note: Classification only. Nothing here deletes or moves a lab; archive-candidate marks a lab whose migration shape needs an explicit decision.

criteria.golden: Declares assertions before execution in golden/manifest.template.json, separates execution status from hypothesis status, and classifies any pre-Golden artifacts.
criteria.migration-needed: Has runnable assets but no declared contract, so its verify step decides its own outcome instead of emitting evidence an evaluator can re-derive.
criteria.archive-candidate: Structure does not map onto the Golden run layout without a deliberate decision about how it should be split.
